items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I raised eleven thousand dollars on Kickstarter, that helped me do a critical recording session with Sangeeta

ctx.x: Well Kickstarter, you look at all the stuff that’s being funded on Kickstarter, that’s people turning to each other for money. And I am doing this film — I need a lot more than what I’ve raised — but I raised eleven thousand dollars on Kickstarter, that helped me do a critical recording session with Sangeeta — the musician with Parkinson’s — and able- bodied musicians that he used to play with — a very critical part of the film. But I’m struggling now. I go to people, I ask people for money. I’ve gotten…
It’s like Warren was saying about that next step up of being a band leader.
